_como_usar: Copiar pra conteudo/carrosseis/<N>_<nome>/_scripts/prompts.json. Cada imagem nova ganha um número novo em images (nunca reaproveitar número: a versão anterior fica). Cena em inglês, curta, dizendo o objeto, onde ele está apoiado, que fica na metade de baixo e 'Nothing else'. Use base_alto quando o objeto precisa subir (postes, geladeira): parede só nos 30% de cima. Rodar: python3 .claude/skills/frase/scripts/gen.py conteudo/carrosseis/<N>_<nome> 1
base: black-and-white editorial fine-art photograph, desaturated, high contrast, fine film grain. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Minimal composition, like a museum object photograph. The ENTIRE UPPER HALF of the image is a plain, smooth, light plaster wall, bright and empty, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing. Everything that matters sits in the lower half of the frame; nothing enters from above. No text, no words, no logos, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look, no clutter, no people, no face.
base_alto: black-and-white editorial fine-art photograph, desaturated, high contrast, fine film grain. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Minimal composition, like a museum object photograph. The upper 30% of the image is a plain, smooth, light plaster wall, bright and empty, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing; nothing enters from above. No text, no words, no logos, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look, no clutter, no people, no face.

images.scene: A dirt path at ground level against a plain light wall in the background: the path forks in two; a pair of worn running shoes stands on the left path, both toes turned toward the right path, and the footprints behind them come straight along the left path. Everything low, in the lower third of the frame. Nothing else. Hard low side light, long shadows.
